changes: Fixes E-Verb on T3 and T7 overwriting Sidechain Compressor's data in a card build with both: the reverb could play other tracks' audio and the compressor's key could break (#696).
To make room, PRE now tops out at 227 ms: settings 124 to 127 all give 227 ms, and so does the REV window. Lower PRE settings sound the same.
Projects saved with 0.1.1 keep their knob values and should sound the same unless PRE is 124 or higher.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware, including reloading a project saved with 0.1.1.
Holding FUNC while turning SIZE, DCY, ABSB or SPD now steps through 0, 64 and 127, as MIX and DPTH already did (#438).
Plain knob turns, the sound and saved values are unchanged.
Beta base update: picking E-Verb no longer shows DSP MEMORY FULL just because the effects of the bank's other Parts don't all fit.
Media only: a new audio preview with Legowelt's Juno 106 chord through dry, long hall and shimmer settings.
Known issue: this version is not yet tested on hardware.
First E-Verb release: original Erbe-Verb-inspired FX2 feedback-delay reverb with size, saturation/sustain, absorption, chorus/grains/shimmer, reverse pre-delay, tilt and envelope routings.
The six main-page controls support locks, LFOs, scenes and MIDI CC; SETUP controls are per Part. MIX 0 is exact dry passthrough.
In a card build E-Verb replaces SPRING REV and DARK REV; PLATE REV and the other stock effects stay.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware at full DSP load or with heavy modulation.
